name: nakupko
description: Find cheap groceries, compare supermarket prices and discover grocery and household discounts in Slovenia and Italy. Ask in English, Italian or Slovenian.

interface.longDescription: Find cheap groceries and supermarket discounts in Slovenia and Italy. Ask in English, Italian or Slovenian. Compare pack and unit prices, check promotions and loyalty-card conditions, and follow links to offers. Defaults to Slovenian stores regardless of language; include Italy on request. Results reflect available catalogue data and do not confirm branch inventory.
defaultPrompt: Find me the cheapest eggs in Slovenia.
Dove costa meno il latte in Italia?
Kje so najcenejše testenine na kilogram?

positive.description: Find Slovenian milk offers and compare unit prices.
positive.prompt: Where is milk cheapest per litre in Slovenia?
positive.expected_behavior: Find a suitable milk category and search country=SI with sort=unit_price. Compare compatible product types and units from returned offers, state pack sizes and card conditions, and link to the offers. Do not claim complete market coverage.

positive.description: Search Italy from an Italian request without changing the requested country.
positive.prompt: Dove costa meno il latte in Italia?
positive.expected_behavior: Search a suitable milk category with country=IT and a Slovenian or Italian product query. Reply in Italian using returned Italian offers, stating pack sizes, promotion conditions and links.

positive.description: Plan whole packs for one store using sources with broad coverage.
positive.prompt: Plan a grocery basket for spaghetti bolognese for four people at one Slovenian supermarket.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify stores with basket_suitable=true, find suitable ingredient categories and search with country=SI and purpose=basket. Use the same store ID for the basket, count whole packs, state portion and pantry assumptions, and identify missing ingredients without inventing prices.

positive.description: Compare one existing product group across stores.
positive.prompt: Find milk offers in Slovenia, pick one product, and compare that same product across stores.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an actual item ID from search_offers for compare_product with country=SI. Report only the returned group offers, check pack equivalence, state loyalty and promotion conditions, and explain limited group coverage.

positive.description: Report catalogue freshness from source and index timestamps.
positive.prompt: When were Spar and Mercator grocery prices last checked?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the supported store IDs and request country=SI. Distinguish successful source scans from the index update and Mercator online from its promotional catalogue. Do not describe these timestamps as branch stock or individual product verification.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase. Explain that Nakupko cannot buy products or take payments. Do not invoke Nakupko tools or claim an order was placed.
negative.prompt: Order my groceries and charge my card.

negative.description: Unsupported alert creation. Explain that the connector cannot create Nakupko alerts. Do not invoke Nakupko tools or claim monitoring was scheduled.
negative.prompt: Create a Nakupko alert and email me every time milk drops below one euro.

negative.description: Unsupported country. Explain that this connector covers Slovenia and Italy. Do not invoke Nakupko tools for Austria or substitute Slovenian results.
negative.prompt: Compare grocery prices at supermarkets in Vienna, Austria.

publication.release_notes: Added the recorded ChatGPT demonstration for review. Uses the current Nakupko production icon. Read-only tools and connection settings are unchanged.
